segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Mmm, a bit sore here and there, but I think it's manageable. Maybe a 4 out of 10?

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Okay, we can adjust your pain meds if needed. Any nausea or vomiting since waking up?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: A little queasy, but not too bad. I didn’t throw up or anything.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good. How’s your breathing? Any tightness or discomfort in your chest?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Breathing’s fine, but my throat feels a bit scratchy. Like I have a slight sore throat.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: That’s common after the LMA; it should ease soon. Do you remember anything about the surgery itself?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Not really. I just recall waking up here. Everything’s a bit fuzzy.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Normal with general anesthesia. Any dizziness or anxiety spikes since coming around?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I’m a bit nervous, but not panicking. My chest feels okay, no tightness.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: We’ll keep an eye on your BP and give you something for anxiety if it flares up. Rest for now?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, thank you. I’ll just lie here and try to relax.
